newsitem.title: USA: New York Fed's Tibbals joins derivatives group.
newsitem.headline: New York Fed's Tibbals joins derivatives group.

text.p: Elizabeth Tibbals will join International Swaps and Derivatives Association as general counsel after resigning as vice president and counsel at the Federal Reserve Bank of New York, the swap group said.
At the Fed, Tibbals worked on regulatory and supervisory issues related to derivatives and foreign exchange trading.
Tibbals will take the newly created position in early November.
ISDA created the post after finding its members, mostly big financial institutions dealing in derivatives, coping with numerous legal and regulatory issues over the past few years.
Some states restricted use of derivatives this year and Congress is expected to take up legislation on regulation of exchange-traded and over-the-counter derivatives next year.

"The appointment of a general counsel will serve to further solidify ISDA's role as a leader on issues affecting privately negotiated derivatives transactions," Carolyn Jackson, executive director of the group, said.
